segments.he: בָּרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם, אוֹר לְיוֹם ו' עֶרֶב שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ צַו.
segments.en: Note This letter was prepared on Sunday before noon — to send it via Rabbi Ze'ev from here — and he was delayed and did not travel then — afterwards he traveled without his knowledge. And after he wrote this letter — a letter reached him via the post — and he saw the wonders of Hashem.
segments.he_nikud: בָּרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם, אוֹר לְיוֹם ו' עֶרֶב שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ צו.

segments.he: הָאִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה, הֵכַנְתִּי בְּיוֹם א' קֹדֶם חֲצוֹת, לְשָׁלְחוֹ עַל יְדֵי רַבִּי זְאֵב מִפֹּה, וְנִתְעַכֵּב וְלֹא נָסַע אָז, אַחַר־כָּךְ נָסַע בְּלִי יְדִיעָתִי. וְאַחַר כָּתְבִי אִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה הִגִּיעַנִי מִכְתָּב עַל יְדֵי הַפָּאסְט, וְרָאִיתִי נִפְלְאוֹת ה'. כִּי בְּעֵת כְּתִיבָתִי לֹא הָיָה בְּדַעְתִּי לִפְרֹס בִּשְׁלוֹם יְדִידִי רַבִּי נַחְמָן הַנַּ"ל וּלְהַזְכִּירוֹ לְהִתְוַעֵד עִמִּי, רַק מֵאֵת ה' הָיְתָה שֶׁבְּסוֹף כְּתִיבָתִי נִזְכַּרְתִּי בָּזֶה. וַאֲנִי מַאֲמִין תָּמִיד בְּעִנְיָן כָּזֶה, כִּי לֹא דָּבָר רֵיק הוּא, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי הָיָה לוֹ אִתְעָרוּתָא וְהִשְׁתּוֹקְקוּת לָזֶה שֶׁזֶּה גָּרַם לְעוֹרְרֵנִי לָזֶה. אַחַר כָּךְ כְּשֶׁהִגִּיעַנִי מִכְתָּבוֹ בִּפְרִיסַת שָׁלוֹם מֵאִתּוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה וְהִשְׁתּוֹקְקוּת, וְשֶׁהוּא נִכְסָף לִהְיוֹת פֹּה עַל שַׁבַּת חֹל הַמּוֹעֵד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, הָיָה יָקָר בְּעֵינַי מְאֹד, וְרָאִיתִי נִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים כַּמָּה גָּדוֹל כֹּחַ הַהִשְׁתּוֹקְקוּת וְהַכִּסּוּפִין דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לְעוֹרֵר בְּרִחוּק כַּמָּה פַּרְסָאוֹת גַּם בְּזֶה הָעוֹלָם, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מַה שֶּׁנַּעֲשֶׂה מִזֶּה לְמַעְלָה לְמַעְלָה, כִּי בְּאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְּעַר לְעֵלָּא. וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה לְדַבֵּר וּתְסַפֵּר לוֹ כָּל זֶה, וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יְחַזֵּק לְבָבוֹ לְהוֹצִיא מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ הַטּוֹבָה. וְאִם יִרְצֶה הַשֵּׁם כְּשֶׁיִּהְיֶה פֹּה אֲדַבֵּר עִמּוֹ פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים אֶת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים ה' בְּפִינוּ לְטוֹבָתֵנוּ הַנִּצְחִית.
segments.en: For at the time of his writing — it did not come to his mind to greet his dear friend Rabbi Nachman and to mention to him to gather with him — only from Hashem it came that at the end of his writing he remembered this. And he always believes in such a matter — that it is not a vain thing — for certainly he had an arousal and a longing for this — which caused to arouse him to this. Afterwards — when his letter reached him — with greetings of peace from him — with love and yearning — and that he longs to be here on the Shabbas Chol HaMoed coming upon us for good — it was very precious in his eyes — and he saw wonders of the "temim dei'os" — how great is the power of the holy yearning and longing — that can arouse from a distance of many parsaos also in this world — all the more so what is made from this above — above — for "b'is'arusa d'l'sata is'ar l'eila" — through the awakening from below there is an awakening above. [בְּאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְּעַר לְעֵלָּא — Aramaic: from the Zohar — through the awakening from below — through the human initiative — there is a corresponding awakening above — the divine response. The holy yearning of Rabbi Nachman — even from a distance of many parsaos — had aroused Reb Nussun to remember to invite him — before Rabbi Nachman's letter had even arrived. This is the wonder that Reb Nussun sees] And there is much to speak about this — and tell him all this — and Hashem Yisborach will strengthen his heart — to bring out from potential to actual his good longing. And if Hashem wills — when he is here — he will speak with him face to face — what Hashem will place in their mouths — for their eternal benefit. And now my son — be strong and resolute — to rejoice in the joy of the holy festival coming upon us for good — and you will merit to be among all those who increase in telling the story of the Exodus from Egypt. For praised be G-d — we have much to tell and to thank — for all the miracles and wonders that He does with us at every time. For in every generation and generation — a person is obligated to see himself as if he... — and so in every year and year. Especially such pursued ones — pursued relentlessly — like us — were it not that Hashem who was for us. [Tehillim 124:1] And on His great *chesed* we lean in truth — that He not abandon us and not forsake us forever — both for livelihood — and to be saved from our enemies and those who pursue us for no reason — and especially in the essential purpose — to merit to draw close to Him Yisborach in truth — so that we never be ashamed. And there is much to tell — but the time does not suffice.

segments.he: וְעַתָּה בְּנִי חֲזַק וֶאֱמַץ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת הֶחָג הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְתִזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת בִּכְלַל כָּל הַמַּרְבֶּה לְסַפֵּר בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם וְכוּ'. כִּי תְּהִלָּה לָאֵל יֵשׁ לָנוּ הַרְבֵּה לְסַפֵּר וּלְהוֹדוֹת עַל כָּל הַנִּסִּים וְנִפְלָאוֹת שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה עִמָּנוּ בְּכָל עֵת. כִּי בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר חַיָּב אָדָם לִרְאוֹת אֶת עַצְמוֹ וְכוּ', וְכֵן בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה. בִּפְרָט נִרְדָּפִים דְּנִרְדָּפִים כָּמוֹנוּ לוּלֵי ה' שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ וְכוּ'. וְעַל חַסְדּוֹ הַגָּדוֹל אָנוּ נִשְׁעָנִים בֶּאֱמֶת שֶׁאַל יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל יִטְּשֵׁנוּ לָנֶצַח, הֵן בְּפַרְנָסָה הֵן לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאֵינוּ וְרוֹדְפֵינוּ חִנָּם, וּבִפְרָט בְּעִקַּר הַתַּכְלִית לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת, לְמַעַן לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ לְעוֹלָם. וְיֵשׁ הַרְבֵּה לְסַפֵּר, אַךְ אֵין הַזְּמַן מַסְפִּיק.
segments.en: And the essential — that you rejoice in what you merited to be on Rosh Hashanah — several times — and in what we hope to be on Rosh Hashanah all the days of our lives. For now this is all my comfort and all my aspiration — to merit all those who hear my words — that they all be on Rosh Hashanah — namely in the place of the holy burial of our Master our Teacher and our Rebbe — all their days forever [בִּמְקוֹם גְּנִיזָתוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁל אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל — in the holy place of the burial of our Master our Teacher and our Rebbe — Uman. This is Reb Nussun's great lifework — to bring every Breslov chassid to Uman for Rosh Hashanah — for the Rebbe himself said that he will work greatly to help every person who comes to his grave for Rosh Hashanah ] — certainly they will acknowledge my good forever. And in this we will always exult and rejoice — especially on Shabbas and Yom Tov — and the joy of Hashem will be our stronghold. [Nechemiah 8:10]

segments.he: וְהָעִקָּר שֶׁתִּשְׂמַח בַּמֶּה שֶׁזָּכִיתָ לִהְיוֹת עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים, וּבַמֶּה שֶׁאָנוּ מְקַוִּים לִהְיוֹת עוֹד עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כָּל יְמֵי חַיֵּינוּ. כִּי עַתָּה זֶה כָּל נֶחָמָתִי וְכָל מְגַמָּתִי לְזַכּוֹת אֶת כָּל הַשּׁוֹמְעִים לִדְבָרַי שֶׁיִּהְיוּ כֻּלָּם עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, הַיְנוּ בִמְקוֹם גְּנִיזָתוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁל אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל כָּל יְמֵיהֶם לְעוֹלָם, בְּוַדַּאי יַחֲזִיקוּ לִי טוֹבָה לָנֶצַח. וּבָזֶה נָגִיל וְנָשִׂישׂ תָּמִיד בִּפְרָט בְּשַׁבָּת וְיוֹם טוֹב, וְחֶדְוַת ה' יִהְיוּ מָעֻזֵּנוּ.
segments.en: The words of your father. Nussun of Breslov. Overview: Night before Friday, Erev Shabbas Kodesh , Parshas Tzav. This letter was prepared on Sunday before noon — to send it via Rabbi Ze'ev from here — and he was delayed and did not travel then — afterwards he traveled without his knowledge. And after he wrote this letter — a letter reached him via the post — and he saw the wonders of Hashem. For at the time of his writing — it did not come to his mind to greet his dear friend Rabbi Nachman and to mention to him to gather with him — only from Hashem it came that at the end of his writing he remembered this. He always believes in such a matter — that it is not a vain thing — for certainly he had an arousal and a longing for this — which caused to arouse him to this. Afterwards when his letter reached him — with greetings of peace and love and yearning — and that he longs to be here on the Shabbas Chol HaMoed — it was very precious in his eyes — and he saw wonders of the "temim dei'os" — how great is the power of the holy yearning and longing — that can arouse from a distance of many parsaos also in this world — all the more so what is made from this above — above — for "b'is'arusa d'l'sata is'ar l'eila." There is much to speak about this — tell him all this — and Hashem will strengthen his heart to bring out from potential to actual his good longing. Then: and now my son — be strong and resolute — to rejoice in the joy of the holy festival coming upon us for good — and merit to be among all those who increase in telling the story of the Exodus. For praised be G-d — we have much to tell and to thank — for all the miracles and wonders that He does with us at every time. For in every generation and generation — a person is obligated to see himself as if he... — and so in every year and year. Especially such pursued ones — like us — were it not that Hashem who was for us. And on His great chesed we lean in truth — to be saved from our enemies and those who pursue us — and especially in the essential purpose — to merit to draw close to Him Yisborach in truth — so that we never be ashamed. And the essential — that you rejoice in what you merited to be on Rosh Hashanah several times — and in what we hope to be on Rosh Hashanah all the days of our lives. For now this is all my comfort and all my aspiration — to merit all those who hear my words — that they all be on Rosh Hashanah — in the place of the holy burial of our Master our Teacher and our Rebbe — all their days forever — certainly they will acknowledge my good forever. And in this we will always exult and rejoice — especially on Shabbas and Yom Tov — and the joy of Hashem will be our stronghold.
segments.he_nikud: וְהָעִקָּר שֶׁתִּשְׂמַח בְּמַה שֶׁזָּכִיתָ לִהְיוֹת עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים, וּבְמַה שֶׁאָנוּ מְקֻוֽיָּם לִהְיוֹת עוֹד עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כָּל יְמֵי חַיֵּינוּ. כִּי עַתָּה זֶה כֹּל נִחַמְתִּי וְכָל מְגַמָּתִי לְזַכּוֹת אֶת כָּל הַשּׁוֹמְעִים לִדְבָרַי שֶׁיִּהְיוּ כֻּלָּם עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, הַיְנוּ בִּמְקוֹם גְּנִיזָתוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁל אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוֹ וְרַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל כָּל יְמֵיהֶם לְעוֹלָם, בְּוַדַּאי יַחְזִיקוּ לִי טוֹבָה לָנֶצַח. וּבָזֶה נָגִיל וּנְשַׁיֵּשׁ תָּמִיד בִּפְרָט בְּשַׁבָּת וְיוֹם טוֹב, וְחַדּוֹת ה' יִהְיוּ מֵעֻזֵּנוּ.

aligned_segments.he: בָּרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם, אוֹר לְיוֹם ו' עֶרֶב שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ צַו.
aligned_segments.en: Note This letter was prepared on Sunday before noon — to send it via Rabbi Ze'ev from here — and he was delayed and did not travel then — afterwards he traveled without his knowledge. And after he wrote this letter — a letter reached him via the post — and he saw the wonders of Hashem.

aligned_segments.he: הָאִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה, הֵכַנְתִּי בְּיוֹם א' קֹדֶם חֲצוֹת, לְשָׁלְחוֹ עַל יְדֵי רַבִּי זְאֵב מִפֹּה, וְנִתְעַכֵּב וְלֹא נָסַע אָז, אַחַר־כָּךְ נָסַע בְּלִי יְדִיעָתִי.
aligned_segments.en: For at the time of his writing — it did not come to his mind to greet his dear friend Rabbi Nachman and to mention to him to gather with him — only from Hashem it came that at the end of his writing he remembered this.

aligned_segments.he: וְאַחַר כָּתְבִי אִגֶּרֶת הַזֶּה הִגִּיעַנִי מִכְתָּב עַל יְדֵי הַפָּאסְט, וְרָאִיתִי נִפְלְאוֹת ה'.
aligned_segments.en: And he always believes in such a matter — that it is not a vain thing — for certainly he had an arousal and a longing for this — which caused to arouse him to this. Afterwards — when his letter reached him — with greetings of peace from him — with love and yearning — and that he longs to be here on the Shabbas Chol HaMoed coming upon us for good — it was very precious in his eyes — and he saw wonders of the "temim dei'os" — how great is the power of the holy yearning and longing — that can arouse from a distance of many parsaos also in this world — all the more so what is made from this above — above — for "b'is'arusa d'l'sata is'ar l'eila" — through the awakening from below there is an awakening above. [בְּאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְּעַר לְעֵלָּא — Aramaic: from the Zohar — through the awakening from below — through the human initiative — there is a corresponding awakening above — the divine response.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי בְּעֵת כְּתִיבָתִי לֹא הָיָה בְּדַעְתִּי לִפְרֹס בִּשְׁלוֹם יְדִידִי רַבִּי נַחְמָן הַנַּ"ל וּלְהַזְכִּירוֹ לְהִתְוַעֵד עִמִּי, רַק מֵאֵת ה' הָיְתָה שֶׁבְּסוֹף כְּתִיבָתִי נִזְכַּרְתִּי בָּזֶה.
aligned_segments.en: The holy yearning of Rabbi Nachman — even from a distance of many parsaos — had aroused Reb Nussun to remember to invite him — before Rabbi Nachman's letter had even arrived.

aligned_segments.he: וַאֲנִי מַאֲמִין תָּמִיד בְּעִנְיָן כָּזֶה, כִּי לֹא דָּבָר רֵיק הוּא, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי הָיָה לוֹ אִתְעָרוּתָא וְהִשְׁתּוֹקְקוּת לָזֶה שֶׁזֶּה גָּרַם לְעוֹרְרֵנִי לָזֶה.
aligned_segments.en: This is the wonder that Reb Nussun sees] And there is much to speak about this — and tell him all this — and Hashem Yisborach will strengthen his heart — to bring out from potential to actual his good longing. And if Hashem wills — when he is here — he will speak with him face to face — what Hashem will place in their mouths — for their eternal benefit.

aligned_segments.he: אַחַר כָּךְ כְּשֶׁהִגִּיעַנִי מִכְתָּבוֹ בִּפְרִיסַת שָׁלוֹם מֵאִתּוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה וְהִשְׁתּוֹקְקוּת, וְשֶׁהוּא נִכְסָף לִהְיוֹת פֹּה עַל שַׁבַּת חֹל הַמּוֹעֵד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, הָיָה יָקָר בְּעֵינַי מְאֹד, וְרָאִיתִי נִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים כַּמָּה גָּדוֹל כֹּחַ הַהִשְׁתּוֹקְקוּת וְהַכִּסּוּפִין דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לְעוֹרֵר בְּרִחוּק כַּמָּה פַּרְסָאוֹת גַּם בְּזֶה הָעוֹלָם, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מַה שֶּׁנַּעֲשֶׂה מִזֶּה לְמַעְלָה לְמַעְלָה, כִּי בְּאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְּעַר לְעֵלָּא.
aligned_segments.en: And now my son — be strong and resolute — to rejoice in the joy of the holy festival coming upon us for good — and you will merit to be among all those who increase in telling the story of the Exodus from Egypt.

aligned_segments.he: וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה לְדַבֵּר וּתְסַפֵּר לוֹ כָּל זֶה, וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יְחַזֵּק לְבָבוֹ לְהוֹצִיא מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ הַטּוֹבָה.
aligned_segments.en: For praised be G-d — we have much to tell and to thank — for all the miracles and wonders that He does with us at every time. For in every generation and generation — a person is obligated to see himself as if he... — and so in every year and year.

aligned_segments.he: וְאִם יִרְצֶה הַשֵּׁם כְּשֶׁיִּהְיֶה פֹּה אֲדַבֵּר עִמּוֹ פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים אֶת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים ה' בְּפִינוּ לְטוֹבָתֵנוּ הַנִּצְחִית.
aligned_segments.en: Especially such pursued ones — pursued relentlessly — like us — were it not that Hashem who was for us. [Tehillim 124:1] And on His great *chesed* we lean in truth — that He not abandon us and not forsake us forever — both for livelihood — and to be saved from our enemies and those who pursue us for no reason — and especially in the essential purpose — to merit to draw close to Him Yisborach in truth — so that we never be ashamed. And there is much to tell — but the time does not suffice.

aligned_segments.he: וְעַתָּה בְּנִי חֲזַק וֶאֱמַץ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת הֶחָג הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה, וְתִזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת בִּכְלַל כָּל הַמַּרְבֶּה לְסַפֵּר בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: And the essential — that you rejoice in what you merited to be on Rosh Hashanah — several times — and in what we hope to be on Rosh Hashanah all the days of our lives.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי תְּהִלָּה לָאֵל יֵשׁ לָנוּ הַרְבֵּה לְסַפֵּר וּלְהוֹדוֹת עַל כָּל הַנִּסִּים וְנִפְלָאוֹת שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה עִמָּנוּ בְּכָל עֵת. כִּי בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר חַיָּב אָדָם לִרְאוֹת אֶת עַצְמוֹ וְכוּ', וְכֵן בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה.
aligned_segments.en: For now this is all my comfort and all my aspiration — to merit all those who hear my words — that they all be on Rosh Hashanah — namely in the place of the holy burial of our Master our Teacher and our Rebbe — all their days forever [בִּמְקוֹם גְּנִיזָתוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁל אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל — in the holy place of the burial of our Master our Teacher and our Rebbe — Uman.

aligned_segments.he: בִּפְרָט נִרְדָּפִים דְּנִרְדָּפִים כָּמוֹנוּ לוּלֵי ה' שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: This is Reb Nussun's great lifework — to bring every Breslov chassid to Uman for Rosh Hashanah — for the Rebbe himself said that he will work greatly to help every person who comes to his grave for Rosh Hashanah ] — certainly they will acknowledge my good forever.

aligned_segments.he: וְעַל חַסְדּוֹ הַגָּדוֹל אָנוּ נִשְׁעָנִים בֶּאֱמֶת שֶׁאַל יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל יִטְּשֵׁנוּ לָנֶצַח, הֵן בְּפַרְנָסָה הֵן לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאֵינוּ וְרוֹדְפֵינוּ חִנָּם, וּבִפְרָט בְּעִקַּר הַתַּכְלִית לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת, לְמַעַן לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ לְעוֹלָם. וְיֵשׁ הַרְבֵּה לְסַפֵּר, אַךְ אֵין הַזְּמַן מַסְפִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: And in this we will always exult and rejoice — especially on Shabbas and Yom Tov — and the joy of Hashem will be our stronghold. [Nechemiah 8:10]
